授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to International Finance. We start
by defining main concepts and developing a basic theoretical framework for the study of
international balance of payment, international capital flow, theory of exchange rates
and international monetary systems. We then apply this framework to contemporary
economic issues. Participants are encouraged to deliver presentations and discuss with
each other in the class.
